name: Beor
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword. Balaam was a soothsayer, a diviner; he was a witch, so to speak.
The reason for the ban: Ammon and Moab met not Israel with bread and with water in the way when they came forth out of Egypt, and hired Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor to curse them.

note.label: Deuteronomy 23: Who May Enter the Congregation and the Holy Camp

points: With the princes of Midian, Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword. This is the same Balaam from Numbers 22, the one whose ass saw the angel standing there to kill him when he could not see it himself. He was the one going after the lust of greed, and he ended up getting put to death.

note.label: Joshua 13: Much Land Yet to Be Possessed

points: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse Israel; that is Numbers 22, read only days before this class.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve

points: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.
